digest/shake#

SHAKE128 and SHAKE256 extendable-output functions (FIPS 202) over the host provider.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Shake128(32, message).bytes(); // 32 raw bytes

Description#

SHAKE128 and SHAKE256 extendable-output functions (FIPS 202) over the host provider. The output length is part of the object: bytes() returns exactly length bytes (1..1048576, InvalidShakeLength otherwise), and successors keep it. A longer output of the same history starts with the shorter one.
